stem.text: Two lamps are connected in series to a $250\,\text{V}$ power supply. One lamp is rated $240\,\text{V}$, $60\,\text{W}$ and the other is rated $10\,\text{V}$, $2.5\,\text{W}$.
Which statement most accurately describes what happens?

A.text: Both lamps light at less than their normal brightness.

B.text: Both lamps light at their normal brightness.
